title: TrustListProvider abstraction
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, Appendix A - Trust Management; QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards.

statements.label: TrustListProvider abstraction
statements.requirement: Trust material SHALL be reached through a TrustListProvider that returns every trusted DSC matching a query of kid plus optional issuer, trust domain, participant and key usage.

sources.quote: Ultimately, every Verifier needs to have a list of all public keys it is willing to trust
